bio.text: Kimberly Hardy, a Democrat, announced in 2025 a challenge to Rep. David Rouzer in North Carolina's 7th Congressional District in 2026.
Hardy holds a Ph.D. in social work, is an associate professor at Fayetteville State University and previously worked as a school social worker.
Hardy ran for the North Carolina House in District 43 in 2020 and 2022 and has served as second vice chair of the state Democratic Party.

sources.title: Kimberly Hardy announces run against Rouzer for district 7 U.S. House seat
